description.en: Alpha for Maxitrol G6R-H4T2 433.92 MHz: direct On/Off, narrow/broad burner mode, longer flame up/down commands, adjustable Flow duration and live command logging. Pair handset address only.
description.no: Alfa for Maxitrol G6R-H4T2 (433,92 MHz): På/Av, bred/smal flamme, lengre RF-sending ved flamme opp/ned, justerbar Flow-varighet og logg. Par kun fjernkontrolladresse.
